findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “Another law which seemed very much focused…”
findings.source_quote: “every seven years the land was to lie fallow for the whole year”
findings.suggested_fix: Change “kila baada ya miaka saba” to “kila mwaka wa saba” to convey that the land lay fallow in every seventh year, not once every seven years thereafter.
findings.translation_quote: “kila baada ya miaka saba ardhi iachwe bila kulimwa kwa mwaka mzima”

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “The biblical book of Hebrews…”; quotation, Hebrews 4:9
findings.source_quote: “There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “raha ya sabato” with “pumziko” (or another faithful Kiswahili rendering of “a rest”), so the translation does not add “Sabbath” to the quotation.
findings.translation_quote: “Basi, imesalia raha ya sabato kwa watu wa Mungu.”

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “There have been several studies that looked at function…”
findings.source_quote: “Probably the fact that inflammation levels are higher when we don’t rest, increases the risks of infection.”
findings.suggested_fix: Revise to say that higher inflammation levels when people do not rest probably increase the risk of infection; for example: “Huenda ukweli kwamba viwango vya uvimbe huwa juu zaidi tusipopumzika huongeza hatari ya maambukizi.”
findings.translation_quote: “Huenda viwango vya uvimbe vinavyokuwa juu zaidi tusipopumzika ndivyo vinavyoongeza hatari ya maambukizi.”

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “I am afraid that many people struggle…”; quotation, Hebrews 4:11
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mfano uo huo wa kuasi” with “mfano huo huo wa kutokuamini” or another faithful rendering of “unbelief”; “kuasi” changes the quoted description to rebellion.
